title: Совет Кости и конверт с адресом  (Kostya's Advice and the Envelope with an Address)

segments.t: After the older lady compliments his strong hands and leaves, a bewildered Max tells Kostya at the bar that the wealthy pensioner is making passes at him. Kostya laughs and encourages Max to try everything in life while he is young, handing him an envelope she left behind.
Даже не знаю, как тебе сказать.
Короче, эта старушка ко мне пристает.
Макс, ну не говори так про Викторию Сергеевну.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'And so strong, too.' Max brings out the contrast between 'both' and 'such' in a few short words.
'It is time for me to go.' The meaning hinges on 'for me' working together with 'it is time' in spoken Russian.
'What is the matter with you?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'why' and finishing on 'such a'. Max answers right away.
Даже не знаю, как тебе сказать.
'I do not even know how to tell you this.' Max addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'say'.
Короче, эта старушка ко мне пристает.
'In short, that older lady is hitting on me.' In Russian, the idea of 'in short' flows naturally into 'bothers' without extra filler words.
Макс, ну не говори так про Викторию Сергеевну.
'Max, do not talk like that about Viktoriya Sergeyevna.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'say' to negate the statement. Max answers right away.
'No, I mean that guest.' The grammar packs 'yes' and 'her' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Just do not turn her down too harshly.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'only' and 'sharply' in a few short words.
'Oh come on, what are you waiting for?' Vika brings out the contrast between 'yes' and 'really?!' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
'You have to try everything while you can.' The meaning hinges on 'at' working together with 'will try' in spoken Russian.
'Go on, get out there and make your move.' Notice how Russian expresses 'yes' and 'act' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Thanks, pal, that is exactly what I will do.' Vika anchors the line on 'thank you', while 'will make' completes the thought. Max answers right away.
'This was left for you.' The meaning hinges on 'this' working together with 'for you' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.

Короче, эта старушка ко мне пристает.
Макс, ну не говори так про Викторию Сергеевну.
